book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Xel yimexe sakwaing wei embei nyeis Yesu yo
Ka Yesu neil qayeeng ti beimambei yon ma woy, moxo neil wou e xe xel betiyeing bei,
“Xam ghe woulek woy bei, bouk yayuw xemou nanghei di yeip zeyi Pasova, ingwei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek xel bong ena wou xel en xel a tuw e lek xax pepeeng o.”
Woyom xel lumuki leitata me xel teivateiv wei xel xomaxoneing qekuma eivek xomek wei lumuki lukanzek, wei lei Kaiapas o,
me xel di luk me yimexe sakwaing wei xel embei tyoxe me na zeimaxoun Yesu me nyeis e mey o.
Xel neil ambei nye, “Ekom se lek bouk wei mata ngandoung o, enok xel xomaxoneing on baluk ngenong de nyeis ama.”
Vex ti taw wel lek Yesu lu nanghei Betani
Ka Yesu la Betani me la toundei eivek xomek wei tambiy ti lei Simon, wei takwei eno qou vanei lepa,
de vex ti lam wou e is botol qakous wei wel xeimangou wei malew ngandoung o, de vex on taw wel lek e lu gyeik moxo di yeip pepenyeing lek zek o.
Ekom xel betiyeing yei tine, eno xel laleind wou nilul, me neil, “Nambei nya vex ne wo nol wou wel ne?
Wel tine teyei bei xey a bo vateivek lek me na qou malew ngandoung me na bong wou xel kanyoyeiw o.”
Yesu woulek inye woy, om neil wou xel, “Nambei nya xam ghe wong nimaying wou vex ne? Vexo wong lul nimza tine wou ay.
Xel kanyoyeiw eno tyek na mi mendei is xam taxombouk, dom ay tyek a se mendei is xam taxombouk.
Vex ne taw wel lek aneing, om vexo wong inye bei menyex wou a neing en eveing eivek leiveeng meyeing.
A neil wou xam zonghek, eivek tembuing sapa wei xel embei na neil Xoulek Nimza nei eno tyek xel a mi neil vati wei vex ne wong ne, me tyek xel a mi bou naleind en e.”
Yudas tup qayeeng is xel lumuki lei tata bei na neil Yesu teyei
Woyom xel xoumeeng yuw on ti lei Yudas Iskariot la wou xel lumuki leitata
me teling, “Xam ambei tyek ghe bong vati wou ay wangwei am bong e nak wou xam nei?” Om xel pyaw memend wou malew teyei lek silva xoumeeng yal (30) wou e.
Woyom nanghei inyon me ela eno Yudas di yimexe sakwaing wei embei bong Yesu na eivek xel memend o.
Yesu xe mata
Lek bouk atax wei Bouk Wei Yaeing Belet Wei Yis Ma Veil o, xel betiyeing lam wou Yesu me teling, “Wambei xa na menyex wou yaeing anghei inya en kandek wang gwa Pasova?”

Moxo neil elox, “La eivek beyeeng ngandoung on me ghe na wou tambiy tinei me na neil wou e, ‘Putoung neil embei: A xe bouk wei xel beyal eno paviy. Ay is a xe xel betiyeing bei nak angha Pasova eivek wa bam.’ ”
Om xel betiyeing wong ambei kawei Yesu neil wou xel o me menyex wou Pasova.
Gyeik ingwei di souk, eno Yesu la dei lek lelek is xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw.
Ka xel di ya, moxo neil, “A neil wou xam zonghek bei, xam on ti tyek na neil a teyei me na toung ay eivek xel vevek amba memend.”
Xel laleind wo nimaying me xel titi di neil wou e bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, Beip se ay?”
Yesu neil elox bei, “Tiwei embei toung mema eivek dipek is ay eno tyek na neil a teyei me na toung a na eivek xel vevek amba memend.

Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek na nambei kawei xel byex eivek xoulek en e yo. Ekom nimaying ena wou moux tiwei embei neil Xomaxoneing Neu Moux teyei, dom na toung e na eivek xel ba memend! Inye nimza, bei tambiy tiyon ta se bou e.”
Woyom Yudas tambiy tiwei embei neil e teyei me na toung e na eivek xel ba memend o neil, “Putoung, neing ayang beip se ay?” Yesu lewexe, “Nambei wang neil on.”
Ka xel di ya, Yesu qou belet, de wong dange wou me dembu, de wong wou e xe xel betiyeing, de neil, “Xam qou me wa. Tine inye a neing.”
Woyom moxo qou mayamya, me wong dange wou dom wong wou xel de neil, “Xam dalus a num eivek.
Tine inye a gyand wei qokatu yo, en a qapyex lek xel ngenong bei e mi semaleeng sewokeing sapa.
A neil wou xam, tyek a se nox me na num wain tine no me e mi na deka bouk tiyon tyek a num wain vako is xam eivek Mang xe tete lalei.”
Woyom xel wong lalo ti, de xel la myayaing me la lukendu Oliv.
Yesu neil embei Petele tyek dax e vun
Woyom Yesu neil wou xel, “Boukeing kane tyek xam xe wongeingis detei, en xel byex eivek xoulek eno nambei nye,

content.text: “‘Tyek a nyeis tambiy wei mi yeiteyei sipsip o,
dom xel sipsip na pek me davuna.’ Sakarias 13:7

content: Ekom tyek a qandi lek me na tax en xam me nana eivek Galili.”
Petele neil elox bei, “Wangwei xel betiyeing dalus a saing xel xe wongeingis en wang, ond tyek a se teyei bei saing wang.”
Yesu neil elox wou e bei, “A neil wou wang zonghek, boukeing kane, wei qouklex seng ghe sesa vya, tyek wang dax a vun luyal.”
Ekom Petele neil embei, “Wangwei a mey is wang, ond a se teyei bei dax wang vund.” Me xel betiyeing dalus neil qayeeng kayon teyeima.
Yesu la Getsemani me la zeimema
Woyom Yesu la is e xe xel betiyeing me xel la beyeeng ti lei Getsemani, me moxo neil wou xel, “Xam a toumendei inye nayaka le, dom a na inyei me na zeimemang bole.”
Moxo qou Petele me Sebedi neu moux luw xouing is e. Moxo lalei wo nimaying me axe nilul ayang.
Moxo neil wou lal, “A nung axe nimaying ngandoung om am bim a mey. Xam a toumendei inye me ghe gweiteyei is ay.”

Moxo dula nayaka, de yeip ma eivek tembuing me zeimema, “Mang, wangwei nambei nyon nei, ond teyei bei wa zeim mayamya tine veil ay. Ekom wa se betiwou a xe woueing nalei, qe wa betiwou wamaxow xe woueing nalei.”
Woyom moxo loumelam wou betiyeing yal on me yei lal di yeip o. Moxo teling Petele, “Se teyei bei mal mendi gweiteyei is ay teyei lek seivma ti?
Xam a mi gweiteyei me na zeimemamim en kandek xam se detei eivek axeing. Laweeng lalei vind bei bong xuk, ekom neing mi wong nimbayaing.”
Moxo lox me la luyuw no me zeimema, “Mang, wangwei mayamya tine se teyei bei ghanaw ay me a num, ond wa betiwou wamaxow laleim.”
Ka moxo loumelam, moxo yei lal di yeip no, en nambei lal mend yeip.
Om moxo ghanaw xel me lox tiwei yal o no me zeimema, me neil ambei kawei yo no.

Woyom moxo loum wou e xe betiyeing me neil wou lal, “Xam anghei dei weip me ghe qou laweeng? Wei, seivma lam paviy, me gweimbeeng xel neil Xomaxoneing Neu Moux teyei me toung e la eivek xel wei sewokeing o memend.
Qandi lek, en xey a na! En inye tambiy wei embei neil a teyei me na toung a na eivek xel memend eno lam!”
Xel zeimaxoun Yesu

Ka moxo nanghei di luk, Yudas, tambiy tiyon eivek xel xoumeeng yuw eno lam tyip. Xel qendu ngandoung lam is e eno xel qou ngeyeing vevek me pebumeeng. Xel lumuki leitata me xel teivateiv wei xomaxoneing eno wong xel lam.
Tambiy wei embei neil Yesu teyei me na toung e na eivek xel ba memend eno wong dee ti bei xel boulek: “Tiwei tyek a toung myang lek e ling ond moux tiyo inyon, om xam a zeimaxoun e.”
Lutika eno Yudas lam wou Yesu me neil, “Boukeing Putoung!” dom toung mya lek e ling.
Yesu neil elox bei, “Gweleeng, wang bong vati wei wang lam en o.” Woyom xel moux on dulam paviy me zeimaxoun e.
Ekom Yesu xe xelti mema la en e xe ngeyeing vevek, de tetei elam dom qateiv xukxe wei lumuki lukanzek on nenyalis tip veil.
Yesu neil wou e, “Toung wa xe ngeyeing vevek on lox eivek beeng, en xel eti yeiw wei puw ngeyeing vevek tyek na mey angya ngeyeing vevek.
Xam ghe wou naleimim bei tyek a se teyei bei taxe Mang, me lutika eno moxo tyek bong xel angela ngenong ghanaw xel qendu xoumeeng yuw wei vevek o me nam devind ay?
Ekom wangwei a bong ambei nyon on qayeeng wei di yeip eivek Anutu xe qapiya vambuing ne tyek se bo neing lek. En Anutu xe qapiya neil embei, lul dalus tine eno e nam belup wou ay.”

Lek seivma kayon eno Yesu neil wou xel qendu yon, “Beip a ne tambiy panaxeing me leiseing xel o, om xam ghe lam is ngeyeing aluw pebumeeng bei bo nol wou ay me na zeimaxoun ay? Bouk tambak ne a mindei eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing me na mi teyoxe xel, ekom xam seng zeimaxoun ay.
Ekom tine dalus lam tyip nambei ingwei xel poropet byex eivek qapiya yo embo neing lek.” Woyom xel betiyeing dalus pek veil e me la.
Yesu nale wou xel kanzol mend
Woyom xel moux wei zeimaxoun Yesu eno qou moxo me la wou lumuki lukanzek Kaiapas. Inyon xel putoung wei petieing me xel teivateiv wei di qekuma yo.
Ekom Petele di betiwou e me la kwanding ka veil e. Moxo la eivek tete lalei wei lumuki lukanzek beeng o. Ka la dei inyon is xel belimbo, bei gyei vati wei embei belup wou Yesu yo.
Xel lumuki leitata me xel kanzol dalus di yimexe qayeeng tyonyeing wei xel embei neil lek Yesu en kandek xel na nyeis e mey en o.
Ekom xel se yeiwou qayeeng ti, de xel ngenong lam neil qayeeng ekom ma. Dekalekom moux yayuw lam
me neil embei, “Tambiy tine neil ambei nye, ‘A teyei bei lelolexe Anutu xe xomek vambuing de na nox me na dev eivek bouk yal.’ ”
Woyom lumuki lukanzek nale ghey me neil wou Yesu, “Se teyei bei wa neil qayeeng ti noum? Inye qayeeng vati ingwei xel di neil lek wang ne?”
Ekom Yesu nanghei toungale kanzek. Om lumuki lukanzek neil wou e, “A teling wou wang eivek Anutu mapieing lei, Neil wou xa wangwei wa Kilisi, Anutu Neu Moux nei.”

Yesu neil elox bei, “Ee, nambei kawei wang neil on. Ekom a neil wou xam dalus, kalekom tyek xam ghe gwei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux mendei wou mema payeiv wei Anutu tiwei Nikanzekta me di lam lek laxap wei tyoung gheyapu yo.”
Woyom lumuki lukanzek lex e xe teimb de neil, “Moxo lukyak lek Anutu yo! Nambei nya xey a ngo qayeeng valu is no? Wei, xam venaxow ghe ngo qayeeng lukeingyak wei e neil o.
Xam ghe wou naleimim ambei nya?” Xel neil elox bei, “Moxo teyei bei mey o.”
Woyom xel pesuv myend louk lek e manghalus me lund memend de venoux e, de xel valu petapexe e
me neil, “Kilisi, wa neil qayeeng poropet wou xa. Eti leis wang?”
Petele ax Yesu vun
Petele moxo toundei myayaing eivek tete lalei wei xomek o. Xukxe vexawo ti lam wou e me neil, “Wang is en wang mindei is Yesu wei Galili yo.”
Ekom moxo axvun eivek xel dalus mend. E neil elox bei, “A loung en vati wei xam ghe di luk en o.”
Woyom moxo la myayaing wei tete mya nei. Inyon vexawo nge yei e me neil wou xel xomaxoneing nanghei inyon, “Tambiy tine mi la is Yesu wei Nasaret o.”
Petele lox me la axvun no me neil zonghek is inyapunei bei, “A loung en moux tiyon!”
Kalekom xel wei toungale inyon eno la wou Petele me neil, “Neing ayang wang on xel xe ti, en xa woulek wa vyam wei wang di luk on.”
Woyom moxo neil vya lek xow me luk ninkanzek, “A neil neing wou xam bei, a loung en tambiy tiyon!” Se denlek en qouklex sesa vya.
Woyom Petele wou kwa en qayeeng wei Yesu neil o, “Qouklex se ghei sesa vya, eno tyek wang dax a vun luyal.” De moxo la myayaing me la eng ngandoungateiv mouyo.
